description: This file implements the UserTimeZoneService class, which manages user time zone retrieval and caching using distributed cache in an OrchardCore module.

classes.name: UserTimeZoneService
classes.description: Service class for managing user time zones with caching support.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the user's time zone asynchronously by username or IUser object.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates the cache for a given user, effectively invalidating the cached time zone.

methods.name: GetTimeZoneIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the time zone ID for a user, caching the result if not already cached.

methods.name: ForgetCacheAsync
methods.description: Removes the cached time zone for a user.
